t: The Brackenheath iSpot G3 Frameless LED floodlight is an efficient outdoor lighting solution featuring an integrated 50W LED and a plug-in modular PIR sensor for automatic lighting. This floodlight is ideal for those installing security lights in residential driveways, pathways and exterior walls. The IP65 rated die-cast aluminium housing ensures weather resistance, whilst the adjustable PIR sensor provides a detection range of 2 to 8m, and a 10 second to 8 minute time delay. With a bright 5500lm cool white output and a 140° sensor angle, this wall-mounted unit offers reliable illumination. This rewireable floodlight with push-fit terminals features loop-in, loop-out cable glands that allow series linking of iSpot G3 floodlights up to a 300W maximum load, whilst the hook bracket ensures straightforward wall mounting.
b: Series-Linkable System Connects Multiple Lights up to 300W
